detail: raw exception normalised to UNEXPECTED_ERROR: safePop(...).value.toLowerCase is not a function
note: A unit-name operand read off the value stack is assumed to be a string. Malformed bytecode can leave any Value type there. vm/VM.ts, the UOM band. FIXED: the unit and converter names read off the value stack went through a compile-time-only `as string` cast. vm/VM.ts now reads them through stringOperand(), which raises MALFORMED_BYTECODE_OPERAND_TYPE naming the opcode and what was on the stack instead. This also stops a Uom being built around a non-string unit, which is what carried the fault forward into unrelated handlers.
